title: Indian Independence Act 1947
definition: An Act of the Parliament of the United Kingdom that partitioned British India into two new independent dominions of India and Pakistan, giving effect to the Mountbatten Plan of June 3, 1947.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for both Prelims (dates, provisions, sovereignty transfers) and Mains (constitutional evolution, partition trauma, nation-building, integration of princely states).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Indian Independence Act 1947.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
